ingredients: Chopped veggies of your choice (I used steamed broccoli, mushrooms, yellow zucchini, and green onions)
steps: Line your air fryer basket with parchment paper.
Add all ingredients and mix together.
Air fry at 350°F for 15–20 minutes, or until the eggs are fully cooked.

Let cool slightly, then slice into toddler-friendly pieces. We use 5 eggs so Mom and Dad each get 2 eggs and our toddler gets 1—an easy breakfast for everyone with just one batch! I love this recipe because I don’t have to turn on the oven, and I can simply dump everything in the air fryer and let it cook while I get other things done.
caption: Breakfast doesn’t have to mean standing over the stove. 👏 This is one of my favorite dump-and-cook toddler breakfasts because the whole family can eat it! 🥦 Air Fryer Veggie Egg Bake Ingredients: 🥚 5 eggs 🥦 Chopped veggies of your choice (I used steamed broccoli, mushrooms, yellow zucchini, and green onions) 🧄 Dash of garlic powder 🥄 1 spoonful of cottage cheese 🧀 Small handful of shredded cheese Directions: 1. Line your air fryer basket with parchment paper. 2. Add all ingredients and mix together. 3. Air fry at 350°F for 15–20 minutes, or until the eggs are fully cooked. 4. Let cool slightly, then slice into toddler-friendly pieces. We use 5 eggs so Mom and Dad each get 2 eggs and our toddler gets 1—an easy breakfast for everyone with just one batch!
